title: Taiwanese American Photographers Association 台美攝影協會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Photographers Association is a photography club serving the Greater Los Angeles Taiwanese American community, founded in 1998. Members come from a wide variety of professional backgrounds and share a common passion for photography. The association holds bi-monthly gatherings and lectures every first and third Saturday afternoon (2–5 PM) at the Greater Los Angeles Taiwan Center. It organizes multiple photography excursions each year and hosts two member photography exhibitions annually. The association also offers beginner photography and Photoshop classes at the Taiwan Center, open to all community members.
